title: Kanbus console on phones: adopt the stacked board
description: The console (apps/console/src/components/ConsoleViewTrack.tsx) gets layout='auto' by default once it uses the new version. Verify and fix the surrounding console at 390 px: the toolbar and type filter fit without horizontal scroll, the detail panel fills the screen with a working close control and the resizer is hidden, and closing detail returns to the same card. features/console/board_horizontal_scroll.feature stays valid at desktop width. Acceptance: console UI scenario at 390 px for board, open detail, close detail; existing console suites pass. Live console check from a phone on the LAN at http://192.168.0.199:4242 or the Mac's .local name.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged in #567. Verified with console UI scenarios at 390 by 844 and screenshots. Not yet checked from a real phone on the LAN: the running console is the installed kbsc, which gets this in the next Kanbus release.
